note: Regenerated after the header mapper was fixed and the accuracy gate was widened. The gate did not score width, height, room_name or the material columns, so it stayed green while the parser read every one of them from the wrong column - a stacked header tier has fewer cells than its data rows, and matching by index read each field one to the left. Provisional: every field in `unknown` needs a human to say whether the sheet is silent or the parser missed it.
